title: llama-annotation-pipeline: Reproducible Snakemake workflow for homology-based and ab initio annotation of the Lama glama genome
description: A Snakemake workflow that annotates a Lama glama genome assembly by DNA-based lift-over (Liftoff) and protein-to-genome alignment (miniprot) from a Vicugna pacos reference, and benchmarks the resulting proteomes with BUSCO, AGAT and gffcompare.
